content: Wɛɛ akà ngye, lɔŋ indiir byàfàlab an'lɔɔŋ a balàbal.
Wɛy anün abaal bàkäl baar a nkwaam, bàlàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, bàŋàtɔɔl mpem, baar a ndandaa unsà làkwikilà aba, unsà ukwen anà unsà nkääŋ a mpem.
Ifà imwɛy sye, wɛy andweer akaar bàkäl asànaa baar inkyɛɛl: bàkɔɔn akal aŋatwee anà anweel a man. Wɛy ba bàlɔŋ ndaa aŋàbwaŋ,
ntɔn ba bàlwɛŋ asye mukwen adim aba anà baan aba,
bàkäl baar a nkwaam, bàŋàpɔŋà, bàler ndwà aba ubwaŋàbwaŋ, bàkyer ubwaŋ, bàkäl anà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n akà adim aba, ntɔn mbuur ukɔɔn abɛy Ndaa a Nzam.
Alwɛŋ sye atö bàkäl anà nkwaam unsà ndaa yanswà,
unsà indiir byanswà. Mɛɛy ngye ŋàkwo naa ngye awà mbaan a isal a ntsà: mpööŋ a an'lɔɔŋ, ibyääl,
ndaa a balàbal ayà mpa ban'kwo musyeel mbaaŋ, ntɔn ukɔɔn aman undiir un'be mutɛn a bi, wɛy un'yiiŋ uwɛl un'tɛr a nswɛn.
Wɛy asɔ bàkäl anà unkyeey akà ankum aba unsà indiir byanswà, wɛy ba bapɛ un'sak anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asà mbaaŋ anà ba,
itàkal muyib akà undiir aba umwɛy, wɛɛ bàswɛŋ taaŋ lanswà naa ba bà bàlää, ntɔn mupà làkoo akà an'lɔɔŋ a Nzam, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi.
Ntɔn, kab a ngway a Nzam alà ntwà a ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar banswà làkyer amɛnà.
Kab a ngway a Nzam alà làfilɔŋ muwɛy nsyääl ambe anà ngyal a indiir a mɛɛn mà, ntɔn mukal u taaŋ alà unsà nkwaam, unsà balàbal anà unsà inzaam,
apà ikadilà bi làkyän aŋàsöönà ubwaŋ anà ilä làsàmɛnà làkoo a Nzam abi wàkölàköl anà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Nde kàpɛ nde ŋakwo ntɔn bi, ntɔn mukitsuuŋ unsà an'kyän an'be manswà anà mupɔŋ un'sɛŋ mwɛy mukal wànde, wàŋàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn isal a ntsà.
Tɛn indiir abi, pà an'lwɛŋ anà ŋan unsà ikɔ̈b kyànswà. Wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abɛy!
